commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Tobias Reichel has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
90+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+3' Tobias Reichel couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) and blew his whistle.
90+2' That was close! Junior Adamu (Freiburg) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
85' Here is a change. Lucas Holer is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
85' Lukas Kubler goes off the pitch and Philipp Treu (Freiburg) comes on.

84' 4 - 1 Goal! Christian Gunter sent in a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) and his precise header from around the penalty spot went into the bottom left corner. 4:1.
83' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
81' 4 - 0 Goal! Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 4:0.
79' Ball possession – 43:57.
77' The attendance is 50000.
76' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to make a change. Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) replaces Marius Bulter.
75' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
70' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe is prepared to thwart his effort.
69' The referee signals a substitution. Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) is brought on as a substitute for Vincenzo Grifo.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Anthony Jung (Freiburg) will replace Yuito Suzuki.
68' Lukas Kwasniok prepares a substitution. Kristoffer Lund is replaced by Jusuf Gazibegovic (1. FC Koln).
68' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) replacing Jan Thielmann.
67' FC Koln take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

66' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
63' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 10:7.
61' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Merlin Rohl (Freiburg), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Freiburg earn a corner.
59' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to substitute Denis Huseinbasic and he is replaced by Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln).
56' 3 - 0 Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the right post.
56' FC Koln are ruled offside.
55' The free kick from long range, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
54' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
53' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Reichel has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
52' Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tobias Reichel blows for a foul.
47' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Jan Thielmann sends a long raking pass onto the head of Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
46' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Julian Schuster probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Eren Dinkci (Freiburg). He is replaced by Merlin Rohl.
46' Half-time substitution. Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) will not participate anymore and Joel Schmied is coming on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+5' Ambitious effort from Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
45+4' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
45+2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
43' A cross from Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
42' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) was quite harsh and Tobias Reichel didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better.
35' 1 - 0 Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) took a great touch to control a beautiful cross inside the box and thundered the ball into the roof of the net. What a strike!
34' A quickly taken corner by FC Koln.
33' The resulting corner from Christian Gunter (Freiburg) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
31' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) makes a rough challenge and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul. Freiburg are awarded a free kick.
30' Tobias Reichel has a clear sight and sees a foul from Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg).
29' The referee is firm and issues Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) a deserved yellow card.

27' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
26' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
24' The game is interrupted now, Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
23' The ball is crossed into the box and Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the right side of the goal, but Noah Atubolu gets a glove on it to thwart him.
21' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marvin Schwabe intercepts the ball.
19' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post.
17' FC Koln fail to score from a corner as Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) leaps to collect the ball.

16' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to FC Koln.
14' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but Noah Atubolu comes off his line to gather the ball.
13' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
12' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
11' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) is penalised for a foul. Tobias Reichel had a clear view and blows his whistle.
10' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

9' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Freiburg.
7' One of the players from Freiburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
6' That's a well-taken pass by Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
3' The game is interrupted. Lucas Holer (Freiburg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
3' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
Freiburg will kick-off.
Tobias Reichel is the one to supervise the game today.
